name: shiny
description: Every Shiny library for .NET in one plugin — cross-platform mobile & device client libraries for iOS, Android, tvOS, Windows, macOS, Linux and Blazor (Bluetooth LE client & peripheral hosting, iBeacon/Eddystone ranging, monitoring & broadcasting, GPS tracking, geofencing, background jobs, local & push notifications, iOS Live Activities & Android Live Updates, HTTP background transfers, bidirectional JSON data sync, OBD-II diagnostics over BLE/WiFi/serial, music library, health data, contacts, calendar, Wi-Fi scanning/connect/saved networks/hotspot, local network discovery (mDNS/DNS-SD, SSDP/UPnP, WS-Discovery), screen recording, speech-to-text/text-to-speech, AI conversation with wake word, core hosting/DI), an embedded AOT-clean HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 & HTTP/3 server that runs where ASP.NET Core cannot (reverse proxy, gRPC, WebDAV, MCP, tunnelling, health checks & metrics), AppDeviceBridge for hosting over-the-air-updated web apps (Blazor WASM, React, Vue) inside MAUI with typed C#/TypeScript device bridges, .NET MAUI components (Shell navigation with source-generated routes, navigation guards, deep links, app shortcuts & typed ViewModel dialogs, MAUI hosting modules, device/app info & store lookups), shared MAUI & Blazor UI controls (TableView, TreeView, DataGrid, FloatingPanel, ChatView, CameraView & document scanning, MediaElement, ImageViewer/ImageEditor, Wizard, Walkthrough, Kanban, Gantt, Diagram, Spreadsheet, Document Editor, Ribbon, Flyout, TabbedPage/NavigationPage, scheduler, Markdown, barcodes & QR codes, motion icons, and more), Mediator/CQRS with middleware and source generators, AOT-friendly data libraries (DocumentDb schema-free JSON store with joins and unique indexes across SQLite, LiteDB, CosmosDB, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, RavenDB, Firestore, DuckDB, IndexedDB and the major SQL engines, Spatial geospatial database, on-device native Firestore for iOS/Android), .NET Aspire integrations (Orleans ADO.NET hosting, Gluetun VPN routing, tunnelling), and source generators & utilities (attribute-driven DI, key/value stores, AOT-safe JSON serialization, reflector property access & assembly info, .resx localization generator, modular MAUI/Blazor/ASP.NET Core hosting, server-side push dispatch for APNs/FCM/Web Push/WNS)
